name: matched-ks3-all-geometry000
hypothesis: Set only geometry Adam multiplier to0.0 so zero spline/warp coefficients remain at initialization while both projection banks learn normally. This isolates the benefit or cost of learned geometry within the same all-KS3 GS32/BF16 implementation, width1024 and fixed backend. It is a fixed-geometry mechanism ablation; even a win would not establish an advantage from learned spline deformation. Retain all KS3 modules, gradients and optimizer state, projection rates1.0 and all shared/model-wide settings.
